## Fixed Issue-Note Structure

Schema: decision-oriented-issue-notes-v1

All current and historical issue entries carry the same fixed fields. A historical observation cannot override current gate results.

| Field | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| blocking_status | blocking, non-blocking, or report-only; the reason is stated for the current flow. |
| issue_class | A closed, centrally defined failure-mode class, listed below. |
| missing_or_unresolved_information | Exact missing or unresolved information; distinguish approved meaning from interpretation failure. |
| user_clarification_needed | none, or the exact user-facing clarification actually required. |
| clarification_type | A closed clarification action, or none when no user clarification is needed. |

Clarification types: make_actor_explicit, clarify_condition_or_guard, clarify_timing_or_qualification, clarify_output_generation, split_overloaded_sentence, clarify_structured_table_meaning, review_source_model_relationship, none.

- parser_or_projection_limitation: Approved text is present; its grammatical or functional relationship is not correctly represented. This is not demonstrated source absence.
- missing_source_information: A specifically identified item is demonstrably absent in the cited approved scope; the missing item and scope must be stated explicitly.
- non_prose_misclassification: Structured content was incorrectly treated as a prose obligation; its existing non-prose output path preserves it.
- source_model_relationship_review: The source checker found a relationship mismatch; affected meaning must not be published until safely reconciled.
- stale_alignment: Existing generated claims, audits or artifacts do not match the currently applied contract; this is not missing technical meaning.
- essential_descriptive_blocker: A required descriptive section or its explicit dependency cannot be supplied from supported approved meaning.
- source_information_not_established: A bounded review has not established a named behavior or qualifier. Neither true source absence nor a parser-only cause is proven.
- intentional_exclusion: Evidence is deliberately excluded by admitted scope or information-gain rules; exclusion is not source damage.
- publication_quality_violation: Rendered text or presentation violates an existing publication rule; no new technical requirement is implied.
- historical_observation: A preserved prior diagnostic has no demonstrated active blocking effect; its exact evidence remains available for review.

Source: requirement\:Main Controller\:IPOS\_STBIO1\_MAIN\_CONTROLLER\_011; offsets 0 to 484

```text
When the HC_EN (ECG_CTRL register [0]) is set to 0 and IMP_EN (IMP_CTRL register [0]) is set to 1 and ECG1_ECG2_SEL (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL register [1]) is set to 1, ECG1 and ECG2 shall be active so, when MODE_OPERATION (DEVICE_CONFIG_OPERATION register [1:0] ) is set different from 0, the O_PD_HC2 shall remain high, O_PD_IMP shall go low and the Device_FSM shall go to the WAIT_SU State, so main_controller_status_register (DEVICE_STATUS_REG register [2:0]) shall be equal to 0x03.
```

Source: requirement\:Main Controller\:IPOS\_STBIO1\_MAIN\_CONTROLLER\_072; offsets 0 to 165

```text
When the i_hc_en is set to 1 and i_imp_en is set to 0 and i_n_ecg_channel is equal to 1, ECG0 shall be active so the o_pd_hc2 shall go low and counter shall be work.
```

Source: requirement\:Main Controller\:IPOS\_STBIO1\_MAIN\_CONTROLLER\_074; offsets 0 to 203

```text
When the i_hc_en is set to 1 and i_imp_en is set to 1 and i_n_ecg_channel is equal to 3, ECG0- ECG1 and ECG2 shall be active so the o_pd_hc2 shall go low, o_pd_imp shall go low and counter shall be work.
```

Source: requirement\:Main Controller\:IPOS\_STBIO1\_MAIN\_CONTROLLER\_010; offsets 0 to 495

```text
[Covers: DDS_STBIO1_0119] When the FSM is in IDLE State, if ECG0_SEL (DEVICE_CONFIG_CHANNEL register [0]) is high, HC_EN (ECG_CTRL register [0]) is set to 1 and IMP_EN (IMP_CTRL register [0]) is set to 0, ECG0 shall be active so, when MODE_OPERATION (DEVICE_CONFIG_OPERATION register [1:0] ) is set different from 0, the O_PD_HC2 shall go low and the Device_FSM FSM shall go to the WAIT_SU State , so the main_controller_status_register (DEVICE_STATUS_REG register [2:0]) shall be equal to 0x03.
```

Source: requirement\:Main Controller\:IPOS\_STBIO1\_MAIN\_CONTROLLER\_1143; offsets 0 to 314

```text
For GSR Operation, if i_en_cds is set 0, the behavior shall as described in Requirement 143, otherwise the o_write_enabled shall be asserted when i_end_of_coversion is set to 1 and i_n_average_ecg_bia_gsr is equal to their limit values when the measurement is done with o_gsr_curr_on set to 0 and o_gsr_on set to 1
```

Source: requirement\:Main Controller\:IPOS\_STBIO1\_MAIN\_CONTROLLER\_089; offsets 0 to 226

```text
If the en_gsr_cds [bit 3 of GSR_CTRL] is set High, the i_m_gsr shall define also in which time slot after the GSR_Curr_on falls from 1 to 0, an acquisition without current injection (o_gsr_curr_on set to 0) shall be performed.
```

Source: requirement\:Main Controller\:IPOS\_STBIO1\_MAIN\_CONTROLLER\_093; offsets 0 to 468

```text
If en_gsr_cds is set high [bit 3 of GSR_CTRL] the GSR_SNS (acquisition with o_gsr_curr_on set to 1) and GSR_CDS (acquisition with o_gsr_curr_on set to 0) shall be sampled 16 times, then mediated to get one single value for each of them, and then the final result shall be the subtraction between GSR_SNS and GSR_CDS. On the other hand, If en_gsr_cds is set low, no acquisition of GSR_CDS shall be done and the result shall be the average of 16 acquisitions of GSR_SNS.
```

```text
Register and memory access coordination: ADSP executes ADSP firmware for OTP boot/write/test and signal elaboration, using mapped program/data/register memory and soft-reset handling. Regmap implements the mapped AFE, system, and OTP registers, exposing configuration/status while enforcing reset and OTP write-protection rules. BIST Controller controls BIST operating modes and coordinates ADC/OTP test operations and their register-visible results. I2C_SPI_AHB accepts I2C/SPI accesses and translates them as needed into AHB transactions for device configuration and readback, including ISPU access. SPI interface provides SPI register transactions to Regmap. I2C interface provides I2C register transactions to Regmap. Regmap provides register read response to SPI interface and I2C interface. Concurrent-access ordering policy: need clarification.
```


**Retained supported content:**

```text
Register and memory access coordination: ADSP executes ADSP firmware for OTP boot/write/test and signal elaboration, using mapped program/data/register memory and soft-reset handling. Regmap implements the mapped AFE, system, and OTP registers, exposing configuration/status while enforcing reset and OTP write-protection rules. BIST Controller controls BIST operating modes and coordinates ADC/OTP test operations and their register-visible results. I2C_SPI_AHB accepts I2C/SPI accesses and translates them as needed into AHB transactions for device configuration and readback, including ISPU access. SPI interface provides SPI register transactions to Regmap. I2C interface provides I2C register transactions to Regmap. Regmap provides register read response to SPI interface and I2C interface.
```
